spectral-capsule-spin.cue: Use foreshortened end-cap rings and a sharp cool rim to read the capsule's depth. Let warm caustics appear as an end turns toward the viewer.

gold-dune-contours.cue: Overlap fine warm contours so close ridges hide distant ones. Sweep a soft highlight across the terrain to make the layers separate.

plasma-squircle-charge.cue: Keep the smoked-glass hub dark at rest. During the hold send sparks along the outline, then let violet bloom catch the hub's reflection as the room cards turn on.

twist-glass-stack.cue: Keep the five thick glass plates legible in a lilac-to-blue stack. Increase both relative rotation and spacing during the twist, then unwind through alignment and settle.
twist-glass-stack.trigger: Drag sideways to fan the plates apart. Release to hold the twist briefly and then unwind.

lava-lamp-loader.cue: Use a narrow neck on each wax blob just before it breaks away. The rising coral wax and sinking crimson wax both sit behind bright glass edges.

candy-knob-toggle.cue: Match the tint of the clear switch and its page to the candy inside. Keep the gummy ring translucent and give the donut matte frosting to differentiate the states.

depth-button.cue: Give each button a clearly darker sidewall. Pressing should close that gap while the face keeps its shape and the group stays still.

tape-measure-picker.cue: Anchor a red hairline while the lacquered tape and tick marks move behind it. Couple tape travel to the mechanical readout and scale the free-end wobble with release speed.
tape-measure-picker.trigger: Drag the tape to extend it past the hairline. Release to snap to the nearest centimetre, or flick left to make it reel in.

cipher-seam.cue: Move the card through one stationary violet seam. Clip the printed face and token matrix on opposite sides, and intensify the seam only while the card is crossing.
cipher-seam.trigger: Drag across the hero to scrub the card through the seam, or tap the white Talk to an Expert pill below the copy to replay.

glass-split-button.cue: Compress the frosted disc to a small pill before it springs wide. Reveal Photo, Note and Voice inside the expanded bar after it has room for them.

popcorn-pop-button.cue: Translate hold progress into warmer copper, a filling thermometer arc and jittering kernels. Stagger each pop and lift the glass lid only after the pile grows.

share-reveal-button.cue: Slide the white cover aside inside a stationary indigo tray. Keep a narrow tab visible as a handle once the four actions are exposed.
